title: WRAITH
tickerText: WRAITH ARE AN INDIANA-BRED THRASH AND SPEED METAL FORCE BUILT FOR MAXIMUM VELOCITY. FORMED IN 2016, THE BAND STARTED AS A ONE-MAN PROJECT BEFORE EVOLVING INTO A FOUR-PIECE WITH A SIMPLE RULE: NO GIMMICKS, NO BULLSHIT, JUST RIFFS, SPEED AND IMPACT. THEIR SOUND DRAGS OLD-SCHOOL THRASH, D-BEAT AND EXTREME METAL INTO THE RED, WITH RAZOR-WIRE GUITARS, PUMMELLING DRUMS AND VOCALS FIRED THROUGH A BROKEN PA. ALBUMS INCLUDING ABSOLUTE POWER, UNDO THE CHAINS AND 2024’S FUELED BY FEAR HAVE TURNED WRAITH INTO A SERIOUS UNDERGROUND WEAPON. THEIR SONGS DRAW ON HISTORY, CONFLICT AND DYSTOPIAN IMAGERY WITHOUT LOSING THE VIOLENCE OF THE RIFF. NOW SIGNED TO PROSTHETIC RECORDS, THEY’RE PUSHING DEEPER INTO THE DARK WITH DESCENT INTO DARKNESS — FAST, LEAN, HOSTILE AND BUILT TO HIT LIKE A LIVE ROUND
